trial_court: Ld. Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate (ACJM), Arambag, GR Case No. 1507 of 2012
case_name: Ganesh Adhikari vs State Of West Bengal & Anr

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Ganesh Adhikari, father of accused Arijit Adhikari

facts_of_case: Complainant Rakhi Panja lodged a complaint against Arijit Adhikari and Raghunath Bera for rape and theft. Petitioner Ganesh Adhikari prays quashing of the proceeding and challenges order no. 20 dated 17th January, 2013.

legal_principles.principle: No court shall take cognizance except on a complaint made in writing and instituted by the concerned court.
legal_principles.held: Shri Chattopadhyay has argued that no court shall take cognizance accept on a complaint made in writing and instituted by the concerned court.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 — Section unknown

legal_principles.principle: Cognizance taken mechanically on the basis of a charge sheet filed by the police is illegal.
legal_principles.held: Shri Chattopadhyay has argued that the cognizance taken by the Ld. ACJM in the present proceedings is illegal since such cognizance has been taken mechanically on the basis of the charge sheet filed by the police.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 — Section unknown

outcome.final_order: The court granted bail to Arijit Adhikari and quashed the proceeding.
